canonical_project: Stadt Bruensbuettel Compact Data Center Container
notes: Dierck Datacenter reference (checked 2026-08-12) describes a modular concrete compact data center for Stadt Bruensbuettel in Kreis Dithmarschen with 4 server racks expandable to 5, 10 kW cooling and 10 kW modular UPS, both 2n redundant. Small municipal edge facility; no MW published. Method-driven searches for Heide/Meldorf/Bruensbuettel found no larger commercial project.
